description: Owner of record for a New York City property: owner name, tax lot (BBL), building class, land use, year built, floors, units, lot and building area, assessed value and zoning, from NYC's public PLUTO tax-lot file. NYC only. Public property records only: no phone, e-mail or people-search data. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
